scope: Direct MoonBit 2D JavaScript comparison; not the four-provider website ranking or a memory benchmark

moon.resolution: local moon.work member, not the registry release

methodology.scope: 2D JavaScript release; both libraries compiled by one MoonBit toolchain; not a cross-target or memory benchmark
methodology.capacity: 16 for both providers; geo 0.1.3 hardcodes its maximum node entries to 16
methodology.construction: common flat JavaScript input prepared outside timing; library-specific ingestion and construction included; one warmup and nine rotated samples
methodology.query: ordinary result-owning APIs; same queries; warmups and calibrated per-provider iterations; rotated batches; full independent reference before and after timing
methodology.nearest: geo query_nearest for k=1; native nearest_neighbors for k>1; k<=0 covered by integration tests; exact ordered distances checked, allowing tied IDs
methodology.segment: MoonSTRtree measured; geo has no segment API in this bridge and is retained as unsupported with no score
methodology.boundaries: identical bounds, nested bounds, empty and singleton inputs; all-hit/no-hit/touching cases retained; k<=0 checked in integration tests without contributing to speed scores
methodology.selection: every declared case retained; equal case weights within common valid two-provider cohort; separate query/build/dataset summaries
